tagline: Quality Garden Steel Shed at a Reasonable Price
sourceUrls: https://www.biohort.com/api/catalog/siwa_vue_gb_en/product/_search (Vue Storefront catalogue index used by the GB shop; configurable products with configurable_children)
priceBasis: GBP incl. 20% VAT as shown ("Incl. 20 % VAT, price valid in GB"); per-SKU prices from the page JSON-LD offers, cross-checked against embedded variant data (no differences). Prices do not vary by colour.
colourNotes: Standard colour interior: grey white (Colours & Sizes tab).
Data sheet EAN columns and the shop variant colours agree for Europa.
SKU middle digits: 2x0y0 where the 4th digit is the size (1..7, 8 = 2A, 9 = 4A).
sellingPoints: Top value for money and tested for decades
Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers
Standard double doors provide generous access.
Maintenance-free for life - 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions.

Functionality: Integrated gutter with a connection for a 1" hose
Security: 2-way locking mechanism with T-handle cylinder lock
Robust roof construction for a snow load of up to 150 kg/m²
Storm-proof up to wind force 12 (according to the Beaufort scale: hurricane)* (* with professional assembly and anchoring)
Quality at its best: Top quality materials: galvanised, polyamide enamel coated steel plate, screws and hinges made of stainless steel
20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions.

standardEquipment: Shelves / support rails: two shelves (length 24.5 cm, width 72 cm) and two support rails; galvanised; max. load 15 kg per shelf
Organiser system on the inside of the door; six hooks included
Integrated gutters: two, with connector for 1-inch garden hose (rainwater downpipe set recommended as optional accessory)
T-handle cylinder lock; 2-way locking mechanism; incl. spare key
Door hooks to secure the opened door panels
Two additional mounting brackets for wall mounting (sizes 2A and 4A)
guarantee: 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions (same FAQ wording as other sheds: corrosion of metal parts and defective/unusable parts; 24-month statutory warranty for wear, moving, electrical, plastic and rubber parts).
delivery: Free Shipping within 3 weeks (product page and every variant's delivery_message).
steelThickness: No figure published. "Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers"; galvanised with protective zinc layer of at least 150 g/m² and polyamide enamel coating.
roof: Classic pitched/gable-style roof (comparison table "Classic, reasonably priced"); light: window available as accessory; snow load 150 kg/m²; wind 150 km/h | wind force 12 with professional assembly and anchoring.
doorPlacement: For shed sizes 2A to 7, the double door can also be installed off-centre. The doors can also be installed on the side wall for shed sizes 4, 5, 6 and 7. Sizes 2A and 4A (short depth) suit attachment to a house or garage wall; two extra mounting brackets included.
sideCanopy: Side canopy 150 cm wide, left, right or both sides; supports always galvanised (not roof colour); not available for size 1 and size 2A; concrete or point foundation needed for supports (side canopy description). Three SKUs per colour by size group: 2,3,4A / 4,5 / 6,7.
groundAnchorsOnGravel: For size 1: 4 pcs. in total; for size 2, 2A: 6 pcs.; for size 3, 4, 4A: 8 pcs.; for size 5, 6, 7: 10 pcs. (data sheet note).
bicycleCapacityFAQ: Europa (max. rim 26"): size 1: 1, 2: 2, 2A: 2, 3: up to 4, 4: up to 6, 4A: 4, 5: 6, 6: up to 8, 7: 8 bicycles (FAQ table).
